protocol.probes: Sequential Eg=L^-1 C L^-T g-g and Zg=B.T L^-T Eg; no E or Z formed. Transient(m,6) generation counted, only one probe processed at a time.
protocol.selector: If delta<1, bound=sigma*(1+delta)*sqrt(h0.T H0h0). Accept H1 iff abs(alpha1)*bound<=entire remaining gap budget; otherwise complete H3. Used alpha1 is charged.
protocol.gap_budget: .25*1e-8*||b||, relative to fixed S3 only; no guarantee for original Schur or floating-point roundoff.
protocol.API_limit: This diagnostic fixes rtol=1e-8; its setup gap budget is not generalized to other solve rtol values.
protocol.endpoint: Adaptive and fixed1/2/3 stop recursive residual<=.5e-8||b||, then verify original<=1e-8. Original exact416 retains original1e-8 stopping.
protocol.verification: Suspected/final only; no candidate residual-replacement fallback.
protocol.order: Rotate five methods by case_index; one repeat.
protocol.scope: One paid native adaptive pilot. No generic novelty claim.
